verdict.rationale: Docs claim ACID transactions across graph, vector, and text data in a single transaction (helixdb-docs-9) and search/filtering across nodes and edges (helixdb-docs-10), implying some consistency guarantee, but there is no explicit documentation of upsert/delete APIs, how quickly vector/text indexes reflect writes, or a stated freshness/consistency model for search results. Community discussion focuses on query language and performance concerns (helixdb-comm-6) rather than freshness semantics. Missing for 10: explicit upsert/delete operation docs, documented index-refresh/freshness latency, and a stated consistency model for search-after-write scenarios.
